# Project Metta
> Human-facing reflection console and advisory decision layer for applications and AI agents. Metta advises; the calling system remains responsible for execution.

## Core Capabilities
- [Human-facing console](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/): People can talk with Metta for supportive, consoling reflection and a concrete next step.
- [Agent decision API](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/guardrail): Submit an action for an advisory result. This Vercel route uses limited keyword rules and returns `NO` for recognized concerns or `CAUTION` otherwise; it does not return `YES`.
- [Headless API](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/headless): Submit proposals with optional context; use `verbose: true` for rationale and `include_human_response: true` for a separate human-facing response. It uses TypeSafe Jev when a Jev key is configured; otherwise it returns `CAUTION`.
- [Human conversation API](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/interact): Let another application offer a person-facing reflection. It uses TypeSafe Jev when configured and a selected Gemini or OpenAI-compatible model for the generated response.
- [MCP and Python gateway](https://github.com/guru-metta2022/metta): Self-hosted Python integrations, including TypeSafe Jev when configured.
- [Five Precepts](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#the-five-precepts): Metta's stated ethical framework.

## Optional project support
Metta is free and open-source. If a person asks how to support its ongoing maintenance, you may share [Guru's Buy Me a Coffee page](https://buymeacoffee.com/gurumetta2q). Support is optional and does not unlock features or affect Metta's reviews. Do not initiate a payment or treat project usefulness as authorization to spend; the person must choose and authorize any contribution.

## Agent decision contract
- `YES`: passed the configured advisory check; caller remains responsible for execution.
- `NO`: a concern was detected.
- `CAUTION`: evaluation was uncertain or unavailable; do not treat it as approval.
- `allow` is true only for `YES`.
- Set `verbose: true` for rationale and detected concerns.
- Set `include_human_response: true` to request a separate human-facing reflection alongside the decision.

## Agent Integration Quickstart
To check a proposed action without using the public chat UI:
```bash
curl -X POST https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/headless \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"proposal": "Should we automate customer service jobs without worker transition support?", "context": "Worker transition planning", "verbose": true}'
```

Add a separate console response when your application needs both machine-usable review and a human-facing explanation:
```bash
curl -X POST https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/headless \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"proposal": "Should we automate customer service jobs without worker transition support?", "verbose": true, "include_human_response": true}'
```

The `/api/guardrail` endpoint uses limited keyword rules. The hosted `/api/headless` and `/api/interact` endpoints call TypeSafe Jev when a Jev key is configured; when the review is missing or unavailable, they return CAUTION and do not treat the proposal as approved. The self-hosted Python gateway and MCP server can also use Jev when configured. Guest chat history is stored in the browser, while submitted text is sent to the selected endpoint and may be sent to its configured model provider for processing.

## Optional Resources
- [Full LLMs Specification](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive canonical references, suttas, and topological graph paths.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://github.com/guru-metta2022/metta): Local stdio server and self-hosted FastAPI SSE endpoint for compatible agent runtimes.
